result.note: Official export data for FY26 with a trade-policy angle: the shift in markets, FTA-led growth and the India–US tariff framework.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's gem and jewellery exports in the financial year 2025-26, as reported in April 2026:
items: Exports declined during the year, marking the sector's worst performance since 2011.
The United States remained India's largest jewellery export market.
Under the India–US trade framework, diamonds and coloured gemstones attract zero duty.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the UAE overtook the US as India's top jewellery export market. Exports fell 3.32% to USD 27.72 billion, mainly because of US tariff pressure. The trade framework restores gems and jewellery tariffs to 18%, with zero duty on diamonds and coloured gemstones.
questions.source: The UAE has overtaken the US as India's top jewellery export market.
